title: Sorted and unique
description:
Write `std::vector<int> uniqueSorted(std::vector<int> values)` that returns the values in ascending order with duplicates removed.

The standard recipe is three steps:

1. `std::sort` puts equal values next to each other.
2. `std::unique` shuffles the duplicates to the back and returns an iterator to where the unique part ends.
3. `erase` chops off everything from that iterator to the end.
